newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-YOUNG CALLED UP AS COVER FOR JULIAN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-YOUNG CALLED UP AS COVER FOR JULIAN.

text.p: Tasmanian all-rounder Shaun Young was called into the Australia squad on Thursday for the sixth and final test against England which begins at The Oval next week.
Young, currently playing for Gloucestershire, was added to the party as a replacement for Jason Gillespie, who has a back injury, and Paul Reiffel who returned home for domestic reasons.
However, with all-rounder Brendon Julian nursing a cracked wrist, there is every chance that he will make his test debut at the Oval.
Young joined Gloucestershire on a one-year contract this season as a replacement for Courtney Walsh and has been an integral part of their rise to third place in the county championship.
He has scored over 700 runs in the championship, including a brilliant 237 against Derbyshire at Cheltenham, and taken 30 wickets with his medium pace.
Julian, who was poised to come into the test team for the first time in the series, had to withdraw from Australia's one-day game against Ireland on Thursday because of his injured left wrist.
"Brendon got hit on the wrist by a net bowler seven days ago," said Australian coach Geoff Marsh. "We took him to the hospital and there's a slight crack in the wrist."
Australia have already retained the Ashes and lead the series 3-1.
